verdict.rationale: Full-text search is a fair axis for a backend database platform, but the evidence never documents built-in full-text or keyword search. The docs cover chained filters and sorting, which are structured queries, and KNN vector search, which works on stored embeddings and is not text search. The MongoDB-compatible API is described only as compatibility with existing drivers and tools, not as a text-search capability. Community commentary notes Firebase's limited server-side query options, so nothing in the pack shows text search over data without an external service.
